status: Local correction passed. Publication and full CI qualification pending.

reproductions.failure: The world extends below the visible viewport
reproductions.rootCause: A 650px game-shell minimum overrides the dynamic viewport height while the original HUD scales against the actual viewport.

reproductions.failure: Production figures are clipped by the original content opening
reproductions.rootCause: The four-column table cannot fit a narrow source-art opening.

reproductions.failure: Map caption and settlement dispatch overlap on the short viewport
reproductions.rootCause: Vertical overlay offsets occupy the same band after the world correctly fits the available height.

reproductions.failure: Settlement details require horizontal scrolling to read their labels
reproductions.rootCause: Long headings retain their minimum word width inside a narrow source-art opening.

implementation: The desktop shell uses the real dynamic viewport height. The existing portrait layout remains a vertically scrollable game.
The production table retains its table and column/row headers, while narrow content openings show Stock, Made and Used beside each figure in vertically arranged rows.
Long labels wrap only within narrow original openings. Larger layouts retain their existing text flow and source-art geometry.
Short desktop layouts place the caption near the top and compact the dispatch padding so their text no longer overlaps.

The maintained control-frame gate now covers two additional short viewports and rejects world overflow, mismatched HUD/world height, escaped figures, horizontal label scrolling and overlapping overlays.

localChecks.types: Application, tools and STX passed; 258 template expressions and two scripts, zero errors/warnings.
localChecks.productionBuild: Passed after scoping long-label wrapping to narrow panels; 36.36 seconds, one generated page.

browser.scope: Focused production UI browser gates after the final correction, including scoped narrow-label wrapping. Full 16-suite CI required after publishing.

visualReview.rasterPublication: Original-media raster bytes remain private; hashes and dimensions do not provide public visual inspection.

limits: This is partial progress on issue 90, not complete localization, accessibility or touch acceptance.
